entities.summary: Jonathan Adagogo Green (1873–1905) was a late 19th-century Nigerian photographer, considered one of the first African professional photographers in his country. He is known as a pioneering photographer in West Africa, notable for his documentation of colonial life and local culture, particularly his Ibani Ijo community.
